Name: Capellan Hussars
Details: The Capellan Hussars are the most prestigious formation in the CCAF, tracing their origins back to the Capellan Defense Force under Franco Liao during the founding of the Confederation. When not involved in combat duties, the Hussars are traditional guards the capital and act as bodyguards and escorts for nobles. Thanks to their elevated status they receive the best equipment and personnel, getting the first choice of graduates from local military academies. To maintain their skills, members of the Capellan Hussars are often seconded to other CCAF units serving in combat zones.
